Turn on the TV for setup. Each adapter i: Turn on the TV for setup. Each adapter instance controls one TV.
Start this adapter instance, then search: Start this adapter instance, then search for TVs in the local network. You can start the instance before entering a TV address. All discovered addresses are listed; choose one to copy it into TV address. You can also enter an address manually. Save the configuration to use the selected TV.
Found %s TV addresses. Choose a TV from: Found %s TV addresses. Choose a TV from Discovered TVs and save the configuration.
No TVs found. Turn on the TV and check t: No TVs found. Turn on the TV and check that ioBroker and the TV can communicate in the same local network. You can still enter the TV address manually.
Found %s TV addresses. The search could: Found %s TV addresses. The search could not check every network interface or TV. Choose a listed address or enter the TV address manually.
The TV search failed: %s. You can still: The TV search failed: %s. You can still enter the TV address manually.
Enter a whole TV control port from 1 to: Enter a whole TV control port from 1 to 65535 before starting the search.
Start this adapter instance before searc: Start this adapter instance before searching for TVs.
The search runs from the ioBroker host a: The search runs from the ioBroker host and takes a few seconds. Network isolation or blocked multicast can prevent discovery. A TV that switches off its network in standby cannot be found; turn it on or enable Quick Start. A discovered Loewe device is not a guarantee that this adapter supports its control interface.
Enter the TV's IP address or hostname wi: Enter the TV's IP address or hostname without http:// or a port. A fixed IP address is recommended.
Enter the TV's IP address or hostname.
Limits direct volume commands to this TV: Limits direct volume commands to this TV level. Remote control buttons and changes made on the TV are not limited.
MAC address of the TV's wired network in: MAC address of the TV's wired network interface, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
Enter a MAC address or leave this field: Enter a MAC address or leave this field empty.
MAC address of the TV's wireless network: MAC address of the TV's wireless network interface. Waking up over Wi-Fi depends on the TV.
Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.
Leave at 905 unless your TV requires a d: Leave at 905 unless your TV requires a different port.
Maximum time to wait for an answer to on: Maximum time to wait for an answer to one TV request.
Leave enabled to use the request format: Leave enabled to use the request format of Loewe App 1.4.7.
0 disables automatic status queries, inc: 0 disables automatic status queries, including the initial query at startup. Otherwise, enter 5 to 3600 seconds. Manual commands remain available.
Enter 0 or a whole number from 5 to 3600: Enter 0 or a whole number from 5 to 3600.
Include current playback in status queri: Include current playback in status queries. Disable this if the TV does not support the playback query.
With 255.255.255.255, the adapter also t: With 255.255.255.255, the adapter also tries a matching local network broadcast when the TV address is IPv4. A different address entered here is used as specified.
Enable Quick Start and network wake-up o: Enable Quick Start and network wake-up on the TV. Without Quick Start, the TV may shut down its network functions in standby and then require the remote control to turn on. Enter the TV's MAC address for the first test and wait at least 30 seconds after switching to standby. The adapter sends Wake-on-LAN, then the TV-on command.
Maximum time for waking the network serv: Maximum time for waking the network service and sending the dedicated TV-on command. The attempt stops when this limit is reached.
Enter a whole number from 5 to 120.
info.wakeReady shows whether a MAC addre: info.wakeReady shows whether a MAC address is known. info.lastWakeOnLan records packet transmission. info.powerOn shows the current attempt and its result; successful transmission does not confirm a visible picture.
Enter 0 or a whole number from 60 to 864: Enter 0 or a whole number from 60 to 86400.
Refresh the complete selected TV channel: Refresh the complete selected TV channel list automatically. Default: 300 seconds. 0 disables automatic channel refresh. Manual refresh remains available.
Turn on the TV and start the adapter to: Turn on the TV and start the adapter to load the available channel lists. Save changes to the TV address or control port first. Then reopen this configuration or use Reload channel lists.
Only TV stations from this list are crea: Only TV stations from this list are created under channels.tv. An empty selection creates no TV station objects. Save the selection to apply it.
Read the current and next programme dire: Read the current and next programme directly from the TV and show them under each selected TV channel.
Default: 900 seconds. Enter 0 or 300 to: Default: 900 seconds. Enter 0 or 300 to 86400 seconds. 0 disables automatic EPG network requests, including at startup. With EPG enabled, channels.epgRefresh still refreshes manually.
Enter 0 or a whole number from 300 to 86: Enter 0 or a whole number from 300 to 86400.
The programme guide uses the saved TV an: The programme guide uses the saved TV and selected channel list. Save changes in the other tabs first. Select a programme to watch it now or confirm a future recording. A direct link is available in the ioBroker instance overview; optional web access is configured under Web access.
Web adapter for the programme guide: Web adapter for the programme guide
Select an existing web instance, for exa: Select an existing web instance, for example web.0. Enable it and save this configuration. Leave the selection empty to use Admin only.
Select an existing web instance or deact: Select an existing web instance or deactivate web access.
For local web access, enable the selecte: For local web access, enable the selected web instance's integrated socket connection and open the programme guide from its start page. Saving this selection may restart that web instance. The TV adapter must be running.
For remote access, select the same web i: For remote access, select the same web instance in the Cloud adapter. Use a separate web instance on the Cloud adapter's host, bound to 127.0.0.1, with HTTP, local authentication disabled and integrated Socket.IO. The Cloud login protects remote access.
Use the TV programme guide, an XMLTV sou: Use the TV programme guide, an XMLTV source, or both. External data is downloaded and cached even while the TV is off. Programme times keep their original source.
HTTP(S) URL to an XMLTV file or gzip-com: HTTP(S) URL to an XMLTV file or gzip-compressed XMLTV file. No provider is selected automatically. Existing saved URLs can be reused.
Enter an HTTP(S) XMLTV URL without usern: Enter an HTTP(S) XMLTV URL without username, password or fragment.
Load source and check channel mapping: Load source and check channel mapping
A manual logo URL takes priority. Otherw: A manual logo URL takes priority. Otherwise use a TV logo, an unambiguously assigned XMLTV icon or an included logo. If an image cannot be loaded, the next image or channel name is shown. HTTPS pages need HTTPS image URLs.
Select a TV channel and enter an image U: Select a TV channel and enter an image URL you may use. Delete the row to restore automatic logo selection.
Enter an HTTP(S) image URL without usern: Enter an HTTP(S) image URL without username or password.
External programme data needs a valid HT: External programme data needs a valid HTTP(S) XMLTV URL. You can still save the TV settings and prepare the channel assignments.
The rows come from the saved TV channel: The rows come from the saved TV channel list and load automatically when this tab opens. Save a changed TV channel list first. Choose Automatic, Manual or Disabled for each TV channel. In Manual mode, search for an XMLTV channel or enter its exact ID. Load the source to check assignments, then save your changes.
Channel assignments checked: %s of %s ch: Channel assignments checked: %s of %s channels assigned. Review the rows and save your changes.
Every saved TV channel has one row. Auto: Every saved TV channel has one row. Automatic uses an unambiguous match, Manual uses the chosen XMLTV ID, and Disabled excludes external data for this TV channel. The assignment column shows the last source check. Check the source again after editing. Changes take effect after saving.
The form changed while loading. Click Re: The form changed while loading. Click Reload saved TV channels again.
While the channel list or XMLTV source i: While the channel list or XMLTV source is loading, please wait and only edit assignments afterwards.
Choose logos from the TV, the logo direc: Choose logos from the TV, the logo directory, or both. Manual image addresses below always take priority.
TV and logo directory tries the TV image: TV and logo directory tries the TV image first, then the directory, then existing XMLTV or included images. A single-source mode shows the channel name if no usable image from that source is available.
Prefer this country when a channel has s: Prefer this country when a channel has several national versions. International logos remain available. All countries requires a unique match without a national preference.
The directory links to external HTTPS im: The directory links to external HTTPS images. Their availability and terms of use are determined by the provider and rights holders.
The rows load automatically from this in: The rows load automatically from this instance's saved TV channel list, even while the TV is off. Save a changed TV channel list first. Automatic uses a unique directory match. Manual lets you choose a logo. No directory logo disables only this channel's directory assignment. Save to apply changes.
While the saved channel list or logo ass: While the saved channel list or logo assignments are loading, please wait and edit assignments afterwards.
The form changed while loading. Click Re: The form changed while loading. Click Reload TV channels and logos again.
The TV image column indicates a saved im: The TV image column indicates a saved image address, not a successful download. Directory assignments can be prepared in every source mode. Recheck after changing a country or assignment. Corrections for temporarily missing TV channels are retained.
Prepare automatic Internet EPG while the: Prepare automatic Internet EPG while the TV is off. Keep your existing XMLTV URL, or use the free EPGShare01 Germany feed when the URL is empty. Channel assignments stay unchanged. Check the source and save to activate. A missing or disabled refresh interval becomes one hour.
HTTP(S) URL to an XMLTV or gzip file. Se: HTTP(S) URL to an XMLTV or gzip file. Set up Internet EPG can fill in the EPGShare01 Germany URL. You can edit the address and keep your own source.
internetEpgPrepared: Internet EPG is prepared. Check the source and channel assignments, then save.
